headline: Product & Strategy Leader | Product x Procurement | Building Systems that Scale Beyond Excel & Emails | Atlassian Community Champion

sections.bio:
I work on products where things are rarely clean.

Procurement, approvals, workflows — the kind of systems that usually run on Excel, emails, and a lot of follow-ups.

My role is to bring structure to that chaos.
Turn scattered processes into something scalable, usable, and reliable.

Over time, I’ve realized product leadership isn’t about doing more.
It’s about deciding what actually matters —
where to focus, what to ignore, and how to align teams around it.

Lately, I’ve been thinking a lot about how AI is changing the way teams build —
and how it’s also quietly shifting where leaders spend their time.

Outside of work, I’m an Atlassian Community Champion,
where I actively contribute to and grow the tech community

posts.text:
40+ people came in to learn Atlassian #Rovo. And walked out with a certificate.
That was Let’s Get Credentialed: Rovo this Saturday.

We learned Rovo Fundamentals together, took the open book exam & celebrated a whole bunch of new credentials.

As a host, seeing people get that “I am certified!” moment was probably the best part. 🙂

And yes, we celebrated properly too.
Chocolates, some cool swags, and of course… pizzas. 🍕
Because what better way to celebrate a new credential than pizza?

And clearly, people want more of this. We were barely done and the question had already started: 
“When’s the next one?” 

Looks like credential events are going to be one of our most demanded formats now. 😄

Amanda/ Marie (Ree) and the community team, this is such a great format you’ve come up with. Certification, learning & community all happening together. People genuinely loved it.

A special shoutout to InfoBeans for opening up your workspace for us & hosting the community in such a beautiful space. Thank you! 🙌

Atlassian | Atlassian Community Indore | Aditi

#AtlassianChampions #AtlassianCertification

For the first time ever, we’re doing something like this in Atlassian Community Indore.

A free Atlassian credential event where you can:
• Come in and take an open book exam
• Get yourself credentialed in #rovo
• Add it to your professional profile
• Meet fellow community members
• Enjoy food, swag, networking and fun

22 August | Indore

Seats are very limited and registrations are going through waitlist approval.

If this sounds interesting, join the waitlist soon.

Very important: please bring your own laptop. You’ll need it for the exam.
Event link in comments.

#AtlassianChampions #AtlassianCertification Atlassian Community Indore 
Aditi | Marie (Ree) Kent | Amanda
